nodes.name: power_boost_9v
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter generates VCC_9V for the NE5532 op-amp supply. VIN connected to USB_5V. FB divider sets 9V output. EN tied to VIN for always-on. This module provides the 9V rail only; GND is common system ground.

nodes.name: FB
nodes.description: Feedback input, 0.6V reference voltage, connect resistor divider for output voltage setting

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Regulator enable input, active high (VIH>=1.5V, VIL<=0.4V), connect to VIN for automatic startup

nodes.name: VIN
nodes.description: Input supply pin, operating range 2V-24V, must be locally bypassed with capacitor

nodes.name: NC
nodes.description: No connect, leave floating, do not connect to any net

nodes.name: power_ldo_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO generates VCC_3V3 for digital and analog low-voltage ICs (MCU, DAC). VIN connected to USB_5V. Bypass caps on input and output. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub.

nodes.name: mcu_control
nodes.description: ATmega328P AVR MCU. Runs on VCC_3V3. Configures MCP4725 DAC via I2C using pins PC4 (SDA) and PC5 (SCL). Uses internal 8MHz clock; no external crystal needed for basic I2C. Digital power domain; analog pins (AREF, AVCC) need filtering. MCU owns I2C bus biasing pull-up resistors.

nodes.name: dac_control
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC. Generates GAIN_CTRL analog voltage from MCU commands. Powered by VCC_3V3. I2C address set by A0 pin (tied to GND for default 0x60). VOUT provides shared control signal to NE5532 preamp stage, likely through a passive bias/attenuation network.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamplifier_stereo
nodes.description: NE5532 dual op-amp preamplifier stage. Powered by VCC_9V (VCC_P) and GND (VCC_N). Left channel (IN1_P/IN1_N, OUT1) and right channel (IN2_P/IN2_N, OUT2) are independent. Each input will likely be driven by an audio source (not specified in brief). Outputs feed PAM8403 amplifier. GAIN_CTRL from DAC may connect to a bias network (e.g., inverting input or reference) to adjust gain; implementation uses passives added later.

nodes.name: amplifier_stereo
nodes.description: PAM8403 3W Class-D stereo amplifier. Powered directly from USB_5V (VDD, PVDD_1, PVDD_2). Left and right inputs (INL, INR) accept line-level audio from preamp. MUTE and SHDN pins must be managed (tie SHDN to VDD for always-on; MUTE logic defined later). Outputs are differential pairs (OUT_L_P/N, OUT_R_P/N) to speakers. VREF typically bypassed to GND. Common GND for power and signal.
